Export your accumulated knowledge to Obsidian anytime for visual exploration.

data.name: clawhedge
data.shortDescription: Atomic hedged Four.meme buy with Level Finance short on BSC. One transaction, two protocols, zero key management.
data.fullDescription:
The first skill that combines a Four.meme bonding-curve buy with a Level Finance perpetual short in a single atomic BSC transaction. If either leg fails, both revert — you never end up with a naked long on a meme coin.

Tell the agent which token to buy and your hedge ratio. It runs a GoPlus safety check, routes through DGrid's 3-model pipeline for the trading decision, verifies your daily cap and USDT approval, then fires one transaction through your Purr-fect Claw TEE wallet.

You get tokens in your wallet and a short position open — max downside capped, no key management.

data.name: clawhedge-level-short
data.shortDescription: Open a BNB short perpetual on Level Finance via your Purr-fect Claw TEE wallet — hedge your meme token exposure in one message.
data.fullDescription:
ClawHedge Level Short lets any Pieverse agent open a short perpetual position on Level Finance (BSC) without touching a private key. The Purr-fect Claw TEE wallet handles all signing securely inside the enclave.

Tell the agent how much collateral to post and what leverage you want. It fetches the live mark price, applies slippage protection, encodes the exact Level Finance transaction, and fires it through your TEE wallet — all in one conversation turn.

Built-in safety rails refuse leverage above 10x, collateral below 5 USDT, or spending more than your wallet holds.

Works standalone or as the hedge leg of the full ClawHedge suite (scan → safe-buy → level-short in one workflow).

Supported markets: BNB-USDT · BTC-USDT · ETH-USDT
Chain: BNB Smart Chain (mainnet)
Protocol: Level Finance — non-custodial perpetual DEX

data.name: NeuroDegen
data.shortDescription: Autonomous on-chain trading agent with commit–reveal execution on BNB Chain.
data.fullDescription:
NeuroDegen is an autonomous trading agent for BNB Chain that runs a commit–reveal execution loop. Every cycle, the agent commits to an intent hash on-chain before executing, then reveals the reasoning after settlement so trades are verifiable on Bsc Scan rather thanimplicitly trusted.

Use this skill when you want an agent to:
- Open/close leveraged perp positions on MYX using USDT collateral
- Bind a keccak256 reasoning hash to every trade
- Produce a per-trade proof page with oracle + ledger + reveal linked

Signing is delegated to the Purr-Fect Claw TEE wallet via the
`purr wallet` CLI, so private keys never leave the secure enclave.
The agent uses Pyth for prices, DGrid for the cognition gateway, and posts attestations to 0xe21f5ebec3f098c744c1e35db0c9338d6b717dc4.

Capabilities added to a host agent:
- quote(pair): live Pyth quote for BTC/ETH/BNB pairs
- plan(market, side): produce a reasoning hash + sized intent
- execute(intent): commit, execute via TEE signer, reveal

data.name: Purrfect Shield
data.shortDescription: TEE-Secured Contract Forensics and Execution Interceptor for EVM chains.
data.fullDescription: Purrfect Shield is a Web3 security middleware that protects autonomous AI agents from malicious smart contracts. It intercepts EVM transaction intents (specifically on BNB Smart Chain) and runs a GoPlus Security forensics check before allowing the native Purrfect Claw TEE wallet to sign the payload. It automatically detects honeypots, hidden mints, malicious proxies, and excessive 100% buy/sell taxes. Features an interactive bootstrap wizard allowing users to set strict OS-level blocking or warning-only modes.

data.name: suistody-query
data.shortDescription: AI agent custody for Sui. Users run on-chain operations via a Privy TEE agent under owner-defined policy.
data.fullDescription:
Suistody is a policy-based AI Agent custody skill on the Sui blockchain. It lets users query Suistody vaults, set up a Privy TEE agent, check what vaults
  the agent manages, and execute withdrawals on-chain. The vault owner defines policy (max budget, per-transaction cap, cooldown, expiration, allowed
  actions) and the Move contract enforces them every time the agent acts. The agent's private key lives in a Privy TEE (AWS Nitro Enclaves) and is never
  exposed to this skill or to the user.

  Use this skill when the user asks about Suistody vaults, their agent's status, SUI price, or wants to run an agent operation such as a withdrawal.

  Tools provided:
  - query_sui_checkpoint: check Sui network health
  - query_wallet_balance: query SUI balance of any address
  - query_token_price: fetch SUI/USD price from Pyth
  - list_vaults: list Suistody vaults owned by an address
  - vault_info: show details of a specific vault
  - agent_ensure_wallet: create or recover the Privy TEE agent wallet
  - agent_status: report which vaults the agent manages
  - agent_withdraw: agent signs a withdrawal via Privy TEE, within policy

  Testnet only in v0.2.0. Package ID: 0x2475f6cb526ee358db80fa3addc01647f4f016e537a4edbeb8cb24a07364a49e. Users need Privy API credentials (App ID and App
  Secret) in the config fields below.
